jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)
 At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 
 About the Project Management team
 The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.
 
 What you’ll be doing
 Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.

 Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.

 Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.

 Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.

 Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.

 Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

 
 What you’ll need to have done
 Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.

 Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.

 Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.

 Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

 
 You’re unlikely to thrive here if
 You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.

 You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.

 You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

 If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.
 
 Compensation
 At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
 Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.
 
 Benefits
 £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

 Company pension scheme via Penfold .

 Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .

 Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno .

 Private healthcare insurance through AXA .

 Income protection and Life Insurance.

 Cycle to Work Scheme

 
 Additional perks

jobs.description:
About Sidetrade 
 Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
 We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 
 Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion : Aimie Video 
 
 The role 
 As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.
 You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Requirements 
 
 What you will do: 
 Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
 Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
 Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
 Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
 Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
 Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
 Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
 Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
 Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
 Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.
 
 What you will bring: 
 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
 A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
 Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
 Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
 The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
 The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
 Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
 Willingness to travel up to 50%.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.
 
 Why Sidetrade 
 AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
 Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
 Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Benefits 
 Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days 
 Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
 Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs 
 Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays 
 Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support 
 
 Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 
 We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.
 If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 
 Agencies 
 We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone
 Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.
 At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.
 I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.
 Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.
 That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.
 You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.
 — Grigory
 
Why Secfix exists
 Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.
 Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.
 We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.
 This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.
 
What you'll actually do in the first 3 months
 This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:
 Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.
 Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.
 Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.
 
What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?
 After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.
 You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.
 Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:
 Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

 Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

 Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next m

jobs.description:
About 9fin 
 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
 
 The Opportunity
 Our Platform engineering team is growing up. Two engineering teams, Developer Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, build the foundations every 9fin engineer and product squad relies on. We now need a senior Product Manager to sit across both and bring product discipline to how the platform is shaped.
 Today, Platform runs on speed and engineering instinct. You will help it work more like a product team. You will own the upfront work of problem definition, internal user research, prioritisation and success criteria, so engineers can focus on building the right things. Engineers are your customers: you will interview them, compare solutions, synthesise what you learn, and turn it into a clear roadmap. You will also own quarterly strategy and priorities planning across both teams, balancing operational and support demand against building the self-service platform of the future.
 You will work closely with two engineering leads and their teams, and partner with product squads across the organisation who depend on the platform. Day-to-day triage will largely stay with platform engineers, so you can focus on the decisions that matter most. This is a high-autonomy role with direct access to engineering leadership and real scope to define what “platform as a product” means at 9fin. You will also make the value of platform work visible, using data to show where it makes teams more effective and celebrating the wins.
 Key responsibilities: 
 Product Strategy & Execution 
 Strategy: Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for the platform product squad.

 Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from engineering surveys, interviews, and usage data to craft clear problem statements, articulating root causes in a structured way.

 Discovery: Run structured discovery with internal engineering customers - interviews, usage analysis, survey synthesis - to understand developer workflows, identify friction, and build confidence before investing.

 Impact driven: Define and align the team around key outcomes and effectively prioritise across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, distinguishing urgent requests from long-term investments that benefit multiple teams.

 Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics that capture platform value and make the impact of platform work visible across the engineering org.

 Team Leadership & Communication 
 Team Success: Create a collaborative environment across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, providing wider context and clear goals so engineers can do their best work. Celebrate platform wins and build a culture where engineers trust the roadmap.

 Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complicated technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 Influence: Build strong relationships to empower your squads to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside your team - including product and feature teams who depend on you.

 Stakeholder Management: Work with internal engineering stakeholders to gather the right input, ensuring they have the information to effectively represent the platform team within their own areas.

jobs.title: CDI - Manager Product Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

 

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Nabla 
 Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:
 Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.
 AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.
 Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.
 Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.
 About the Role
 The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.
 This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.
 You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.
 Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.
 This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.
 Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.
 Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:
 Self-serve clinicians , who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

 Mid-market and enterprise health systems , managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

 You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.
 
 Responsibilities
 Feature Launch Positioning & Activation 
 Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

 Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

 Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

 Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

 Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

 Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

 Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

 Lifecycle Strategy and Execution 
 Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

 Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:
 For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

 For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

 
 Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

 Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

 Experimentation and Analytics 
 Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

 Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

 Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

 Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

 Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

 Ensure all programs are developed and execu

Project Manager - Facility Management
jobs.description:
Over CBRE Global Workplace Solutions 

 CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen.

 Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. Onze teams leveren innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van technisch onderhoud, facility management, energiebeheer, projecten en werkplekoptimalisatie.

 Bij CBRE geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Daarom investeren we in ontwikkeling, samenwerking en een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen kan groeien. CBRE wordt wereldwijd erkend als een van de meest bewonderde en ethische bedrijven in haar sector en staat bekend om haar focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en talentontwikkeling.

 Taken

 WAT GA JE DOEN? 
Ben jij een ervaren Project Manager met een technische achtergrond en een passie voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe projecten?

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it

 Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

 Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

 AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

 We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

 In this role, you'll...

 
 
 
 Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.

 Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.

 Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.

 Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.

 Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

 

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.
 Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.
 You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

 Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

 Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

 Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

 Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

 Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

 Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

 Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

 
 About You 
 Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

 Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

 Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

 Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

 Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

 Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

 Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

 Kaluza est la plateforme d’intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.
 Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée au quotidien.
 Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.
 
 Ce que tu feras 
 Tu es responsable des résultats de ton produit et tu donnes aux équipes design et ingénierie une vision claire des priorités et du périmètre.
 Travailler avec l’équipe qui construit notre solution de centre de contact et le Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE), au service d’ENGIE France

 Définir la stratégie produit et la roadmap Customer Care pour les clients de Kaluza en France, en équilibrant réutilisation du Global Core et besoins de localisation

 Construire notre suite d’outils pour le centre de contact, dont le CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) et le Case Management, pour des conversations efficaces et à forte valeur

 Utiliser les dernières technologies d’IA pour automatiser et personnaliser l’expérience client, et porter les outils de productivité des agents

 Être l’interlocuteur produit senior de nos clients (comme ENGIE) : animer des ateliers et traduire leurs besoins en capacités scalables

 Piloter les équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, data, commercial) pour une livraison efficace, en levant les blocages et les dépendances

 Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés du centre de contact (AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS) pour obtenir des gains mesurables sur le coût du service
 

 Ce que tu apportes 
 Idéalement, tu as :
 Une solide expérience de leadership produit en SaaS entreprise, au sein d’organisations produit agiles

 Une connaissance approfondie des opérations de centre de contact et des workflows des agents, et de l’enthousiasme pour l’automatisation par l’IA (voicebots, agent assist)

 Une expérience avec des clients entreprise français et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de localisation (langue, réglementation)

 De l’aisance avec les parties prenantes au niveau exécutif et la capacité d’arbitrer entre rapidité et valeur à long terme

 Une approche orientée data : tu t’appuies sur les métriques opérationnelles pour évaluer la performance produit et progresser en continu

 Un parcours dans la vente d’énergie ou les utilities (un vrai plus !)
 

 Nos valeurs 
 Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :
 Jouer pour gagner : Une fierté collective à décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

 Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller à l’essentiel dans la complexité pour viser des résultats concrets.

 Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

 Assumer le résultat : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

 Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.
 

 Nos avantages 
 Finance & assurances : Prime discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, prévoyance décès/invalidité x3 via Alan, et cotisations de Sécurité sociale standard (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

 Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

 Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + RTT, congé Moments That Matter (Compassionate Leave), deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, travail flexible et possibilité de congé sabbatique
 

 Viens comme tu es 
 Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous les horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur le mérite et le potentiel. Si le poste t’enthousiasme mais que tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis d’échanger avec toi.

jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager 

 Location: Paris — Hybrid - 3 days in office

 Team: Product Management - Customer Care Value Stream

 Reporting to: Head of Product
 
 This role is based in France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to France. 
 At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship 
 
Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English. 
 
 Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.
 By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.
 With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.
 Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working 
 You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.
 This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France , while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.
 What will I be doing? 
 As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.
 You will: 
 Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

 Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

 Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

 Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

 Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

 Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

 Is this the job for me? 
 You are the right person for us if you:
 Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

 Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

 Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

 Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level , with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

 Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

 Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

 Are excited by AI-driven automation , including voice bots and agent assist technology.

 Kaluza Values 
 Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:
 Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together 
  
 We want the best people 
 We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.
 We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

 Deep in the wording. Fast in the build. 

 About Insify 

 Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

 We're doing it differently.

 Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

 We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

 Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

 What you’ll own in your first year 
 You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

 
 Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.

 Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.

 Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.

 Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.

 Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

 
 Who you are 
 You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

 You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.

 You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be . Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.

 You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market , and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.

 You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.

 You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.

 You think like the customer : plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.

 You’re at home in Excel and data , and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.

 You work fluently in English ; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

 What we offer 

 Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.

 Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.

 A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.

 A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.

 Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.

 The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).

 The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

 If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Energiewirtschaft steckt mitten in der größten Transition ihrer Geschichte. Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter brauchen Software, die da mithält, und sie brauchen jemanden, der ihnen klar und glaubwürdig erklärt, warum epilot genau die richtige Plattform ist.
 Als Senior Product Marketing Manager bist du genau diese Stimme im Markt. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir epilot als zentrale, AI-native Plattform für die neue Energiewelt positionieren. Und du sorgst dafür, dass Marketing, Sales und Customer Success eine gemeinsame Geschichte erzählen.
 Product Marketing ist für dich das Fundament jeder Kommunikation und nicht nur der Lieferant für Slides und Battle Cards? Dann lies weiter.
 epilot ist das XRM für die Energiewirtschaft: Unsere Plattform verbindet nicht nur Kund:innen, sondern auch Partner, Installateure, Lieferanten und interne Teams. Über 200 Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber arbeiten bereits damit, und unser Team aus über 120 Menschen wächst weiter. Wenn du Teil dieser Journey sein und epilot an entscheidender Stelle voranbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

 Das erwartet dich 
 Positionierung und Messaging der epilot Plattform liegen in deiner Verantwortung, für Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter. Produktfunktionen übersetzt du in Mehrwerte, die bei allen wichtigen Personas ankommen.

 Nah am Markt: In Sales-Calls, im Gespräch mit Kund:innen und auf Branchenevents erfährst du, was Energieversorger gerade umtreibt. Daraus hältst du ICPs, Personas und Wettbewerbsanalysen aktuell und machst sie zu Wissen, mit dem das ganze Unternehmen arbeitet.

 Produktkampagnen und Markteinführungen steuerst du inhaltlich, von der Story bis zu den Kernbotschaften, gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign & Growth Marketing. Auch die inhaltliche Qualität unserer Produktseiten und weitere produktnahe Inhalte liegt in deiner Verantwortung.

 Sales und Customer Success machst du sprechfähig: mit Pitch-Materialien, Argumentationshilfen, Einwandbehandlung und Trainings.

 AI-gestützte Workflows für Product Marketing baust du auf und entwickelst sie weiter, etwa für Persona- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Messaging oder Sales-Materialien. AI ist für dich kein Knopfdruck: Die Logik dahinter entwickelst du selbst.

 Unsere Junior Product Marketing Managerin führst du fachlich und begleitest sie in ihrer Entwicklung.

 Strategy, Produktmanagement, Sales, Customer Success, Campaign & Growth sowie Event Marketing schätzen dich als Sparringspartner:in. 

 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing , idealerweise im Product Marketing. Positionierung und Messaging hast du schon selbst verantwortet.

 Komplexe Produkte verstehst du schnell und erklärst sie einfach. Dabei findest du die Worte, bei denen Zielgruppen nicken, und nicht die, die nur intern gut klingen.

 Strategisch denken und selbst anpacken gehören für dich zusammen. Ein Messaging-Framework entwickelst du ebenso gern wie eine Produktseite oder einen Sales-Pitch. Auf ein Briefing wartest du nicht: Wo es eine klare Story braucht, bringst du sie auf den Weg.

 AI-Tools nutzt du nicht nur. Am liebsten baust du eigene Workflows, statt dich auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen.

 Neugier auf die Energiewirtschaft ist entscheidend. Branchenerfahrung oder Wissen über Energieprozesse ist ein großes Plus, wichtiger ist aber deine Lust, tief einzutauchen.

 Überzeugungskraft: Stakeholder bis hin zum C-Level gewinnst du mit klaren Argumenten. Außerdem macht es dir Freude, andere fachlich zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln.

 Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch auf C2-Niveau ist ein Muss, denn dein Messaging muss im deutschen Markt sitzen. Dazu sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Unternehmenssprache.

 
 Das bieten wir dir 
 Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote arbeiten, wann immer es passt, und regelmäßig in Köln zusammenkommen, wenn persönlicher Austausch zählt.

 Die Möglichkeit, die erfolgreichste SaaS-Plattform auf dem Energiemarkt mit aufzubauen.

 Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

 Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

 Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

 Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

 Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

 Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

 Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, ein Gym um die Ecke u.v.m.

 
Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen 💙 promise.epilot.cloud/

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen.  Was machst du dabei konkret? 
 Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten.

 Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung.

Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen.

 Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.

 Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups).

 Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern.

 Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung.

 Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

 Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

 Das bieten wir dir: 
 Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

 Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

 Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

 Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

 Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

We're transforming financial services through bold innovation and relentless execution. You bring the ideas and drive. We'll build what's next — together.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - SAP BW Modernization (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Decathlon Digital recherche un·e Chef·fe de Projet Senior - Modernisation SAP BW (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille. Au cœur de la transformation technologique de notre Value Chain, notre équipe est responsable de la donnée d'entreprise. 

Notre grand défi est la modernisation de notre environnement de données et analytique, allant d'un SAP BW On-Premise vers le Cloud - PCE ("Lift and Shift" SAP BW vers le Cloud), jusqu'à l'implémentation et la migration progressive vers SAP Business Data Cloud et SAP Datasphere. Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est évoluer dans un environnement agile, où chaque donnée compte pour rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

En tant que pilier technique et méthodologique, tu seras responsable de la stratégie de modernisation de notre écosystème de données. Tes missions principales incluent:

  • Pilotage du "Lift and Shift" SAP BW: Tu diriges la phase de migration initiale de notre environnement SAP BW actuel vers le Cloud (Private Cloud Edition).
  • Stratégie de Migration Progressive: Tu orchestres l'implémentation et la bascule graduelle vers notre nouvelle architecture cible sur SAP BDC (Business Data Cloud) et SAP Datasphere.
  • Écosystème et Continuité: Tu sécurises les flux de données et garantis une continuité totale du reporting et de l'analytique sans aucune régression pour les utilisateurs métiers.
  • Animation transverse: Tu coordonnes les équipes techniques et produits, animes la gouvernance du projet, gères les répétitions de bascule et pilotes l'accompagnement au changement.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Une expertise confirmée en architecture SAP BW et en gestion de projet SAP, avec une expérience concrète sur SAP Datasphere (ou implémentations de projets SAP/Data similaires).
  • Une expérience solide en gestion de projets de migration de données complexes.
  • Une capacité à naviguer dans des modèles de données complexes tout en gardant une vision stratégique et technique claire.
  • Ta rigueur analytique, ta résistance au stress lors des phases de cutover et ton aisance pour animer des instances de gouvernance internationales.

STACK TECHNIQUE SAP BW, HANA, SAP BDC, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows);
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale);
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.);
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE 

Chez DECATHLON, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
jobs.description:
The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.
 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
 Product Strategy and Roadmap
 Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.

 Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting.

 Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination.

 Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden.

 Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing.

 Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

 Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

 Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection.

 Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

 Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

 Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.
 

 PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.
 
 
 Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
 Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required).

 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required).

 Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required).

 Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required).

 Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required).

 Fluent English (required).

 Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required).

 Preferred: French language skills.

 Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

 Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)).

 Quality Standards

 Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

 Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

 Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

 Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

 Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

 Practices universal safety precautions.

 Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

 Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

 Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

 Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

 
 Travel
 This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.
