jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Healthcare)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Consumer Health 
 
 Position: Senior Product Manager
 Location: Zürich, on-site
 Job Type: Permanent, full-time 
 Start Date: As soon as possible
 Language: English (German is a plus)

 About Us 
 We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. Our vision is to make complex medical data accessible, understandable and actionable for everyone through responsible use of AI. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.
 
 The Role 

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

 Define a roadmap focused on immediate "time-to-value" and features that amaze its users.

 Identify and deeply understand the needs, pain points, and user journeys of patients and healthcare professionals to design compelling and engaging user interface mocks.

 Engineer partner- and product-led growth mechanics for instant onboarding and shareable moments.

 Balance the fast iteration of a consumer app with the safety and quality required for medical software, consider privacy by design.

 Lead cross-functionally, measuring success by user delight, growth and retention.

 
 What You Bring 
 5+ years in Product Management, ideally in high-growth startups.

 Hands-on experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

 Proven experience engaging directly with customers and users to understand their needs, validate ideas, and co-create product solutions that deliver value

 AI-native expertise: you know how to embed AI into the product and your own workflow.

 Experience with design tools and/or rapid prototype software, e.g., Figma, Lovable, Claude Code, to effectively convey ideas and explore options.

 Skills to prepare and deliver technical presentations to senior leadership and/or investors in an inspiring way.

 A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, structure ambiguous problems yourself and deliver, reliably and on time.

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Proven success building outstanding, consumer-grade applications in complex regulated verticals (e.g. Healthtech, Fintech).

 A technical background and/or deep technical understanding of common development processes.

 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the product from day one. Take a core PM role on the founding team of an ambitious AI healthcare startup, with real ownership over the product, how we work and, later, the product team.

 Make healthcare work better for everyone. Help people understand and act on their own health data, and give physicians and partners the tools to spend less time on admin and more on care.

 Grow in the heart of Zurich. Work side by side with the team in our collaborative office and benefit from our network of industry leaders, domain experts, top-tier talent and investors.

 
 Engagement Details
 
 This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, but strongly believe in the power and magic to collaborate most working days together in the office.
 You will join a small team in a fast moving environment. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team initially.

jobs.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)
 Reporting to: VP of Marketing
 
 
 About Cyclomedia & The Role

 Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.
 
 
 In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

 The Role & Collaboration 

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

 Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

 Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

 First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

 

 Your Profile 
 
 
 Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

 Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

 Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

 Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow. 
 
 

 What We Offer 
 
 
 Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

 A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

 A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

 Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

 Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

 Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

 Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

 The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

jobs.description:
About Taurus 
 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

 A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

 As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
 Note 
 We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

 Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

 Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

 Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

 Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

 Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

 Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

 Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

 
 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

 Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

 Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

 A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

 A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

 Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

 
 You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ 
 Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information,

jobs.title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 
 

 We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
 

 Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.

 Responsibilities 
 

 
 Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do.

 
 Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next.

 
 Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust.

 
 Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering.

 
 Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle.

 
 Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team.

 Requirements 
 

 
 You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them.

 
 You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business.
You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree.

 
 You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt.

 
 You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results.

 
 You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field.

 
 You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares.

 
 You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe.

 Plus 
 

 
 You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers.

 
 You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market.

 If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Technology Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 
 We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.
 This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .
 You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.
 Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.
 This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.
 
 What you will do 
 Technology & Product Narrative 
 Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

 Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

 Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

 Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

 Messaging & Positioning Framework 
 Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

 Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

 Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

 Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

 Content Strategy & Creation 
 Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

 Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

 Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

 Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) 
 Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

 Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

 Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

 Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

 Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

 
 Who you are 
 Experience & Skills 
 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

 You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

 Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

 Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

 Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

 Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

 Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

 Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

 Fluent in English, written and spoken.
 

 Ways of working 
 Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

 Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

 Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

 Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Retail Media)
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 Millions of people come to Carwow when they are ready to change their car. That is some of the highest-intent automotive audience in the UK, and it makes Carwow one of the most valuable places for dealers and manufacturers to reach buyers at the moment of decision. Retail media is how we turn that intent into revenue, for our partners and for the business.
 We have built the foundations: sponsored placements across the buying journey, a growing media and audience offering, and commercial products for dealers and manufacturers. Demand is ahead of what we can currently serve. If we can make our advertising products smarter, more relevant and easier to buy, we grow revenue for partners while keeping the experience useful for the consumer. That balance is the job.
 This role is the product voice for retail media: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to build it.
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Advertisers want smarter targeting, better recommendations on where to spend, and proof of what worked. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.
 If you know retail media inside out, want to shape a fast-growing revenue line, and build things with a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for Carwow's retail media products, defining what we build, in what order, and why

 Lead discovery with advertisers and internal teams: interviews, campaign data and marketplace analysis, to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

 Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into our advertising products: smarter targeting, relevancy and recommendations that actually change results Work in partnership with the Technical Engineering Manager and Designer, and collaborate with the engineers in your team, to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives revenue, advertiser performance and consumer relevance, not just activity

 
 Technical & Data Partnership: 
 Work closely with engineers on how ads are served, targeted, priced and measured, and make sound trade-offs between build, buy and integrate

 Own measurement: run controlled tests so every new placement or format proves its revenue impact without harming the consumer experience

 Use data directly, interrogating campaign and marketplace performance to guide decisions

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, commercial, campaign operations and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

 Support the commercial team in partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

 
 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 Proven retail media experience is a prerequisite: you have built or owned sponsored ads, onsite media or audience products at a marketplace, retailer or ad tech business, and you know how the industry works

 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of growing advertising revenue or advertiser performance

 Technically strong: you understand ad serving, targeting, auction and pricing mechanics, APIs and tracking, and can hold a credible conversation with engineers about architecture and trade-offs

 Comfortable with data: you interrogate performance data yourself, design your own tests, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for analysis to land in your inbox

 Great stakeholder skills: you build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, advertisers and senior leaders, push back when needed, and come with solutions rather than problems

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 NICE TO HAVE

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer | 36labs
jobs.description:
Role: Lead Product Engineer
 Company: 36 Labs 
 Location: London, on site four days a week. The office is on Baker Street and moves to Primrose Hill within a couple of months. London-based candidates only.
 Job Type: Full-time
 About 36 Labs
 36 Labs is an applied AI research firm in London. It is working on a gap in today's models: they are weak at creative decisions and at explaining why a decision was made. The team's thesis is that if you solve creativity in LLMs, you have largely solved what captures human attention.
 The product is a harness that sits over any frontier model, especially video generation models. It runs ideation, generation and distribution end to end. Content goes out to real audiences, and a data loop improves the harness over time.
 The company is profitable and works with Sony, Warner and Universal through bespoke marketing partnerships. Marketing is the proof of concept, not the destination. A B2C offering is due very soon. V3 of the harness is being released internally, and it is a big scope of work.
 The team is ten people, with four engineers working under a CTO who is still hands-on in the code. The seed round closes in the next couple of weeks. This is a new stage of growth, not a replacement hire.
 What you are expected to do:
 Own the upcoming B2C product end to end, from launch: an AI-native, customer-facing product where UX matters as much as the models behind it.

 Lead product engineering: make product calls with the founders, set the bar for how things get shipped, and help shape the team as it grows.

 Work across the stack on the harness and the products around it. The structure is flat, so engineers work on a bit of everything, depending on what is needed.

 Help build and ship on top of V3 of the harness as it moves from internal release into wider use.

 Take ownership of your pieces of work and move them forward with little hand-holding.

 Work closely with the CTO and the other engineers, and explain your ideas back to the team.

 What you need to succeed:
 You have four or more years of hands-on engineering experience, including in the AI-native era.

 You have owned something before, and you can point to it.

 You take the lead. You see what needs doing and start, without waiting to be told.

 You communicate well. You explain your thinking clearly and enjoy discussing it.

 You live in London and are happy to be in the office four days a week.

 You do not need visa sponsorship at this stage. The company cannot sponsor until about February next year. A visa that runs well past February is fine.

 You work with Python, TypeScript and Postgres, and you know LLM and generative model APIs and open-weight models.

 You build and run back-end systems in production, including deployment and operation. This is a strong plus.

 You keep up with the latest stacks, models and engineering practices, and you have side projects beyond your degree or day job.

 A degree in computer science, engineering, maths, stats or similar is a plus, and so is an MSc or PhD. The university matters little, and experience matters more.

 Experience in applied generative media or creative companies, such as Fal, is a plus. What you have built matters more than who you built it for.

 A notice period of one month is fine.

 What you get:
 A seed-stage company with a profitable track record since it began operating.

 A strong CV line, and the chance to learn a lot quickly.

 Clear room to grow into a more senior role. The long-term plan is for the CTO to move to strategy and the bigger picture.

 Work on a problem few companies are tackling, with an extremely high ceiling.

 Real clients from day one, including Sony, Warner and Universal.

 A small, flat team of ten, with direct access to the CTO and the founders.

 How to apply
 Send your LinkedIn profile or CV to Alexander at the agency. We start with a short screening call. After that, the process runs as follows. First, a first-round interview with Benedict, head of operations, covering your projects, CV and motivation. Second, a technical interview with the CTO of about half an hour. Third, a take-home technical assessment. If the team cannot decide between candidates, there may be a final onsite round where you work on something in front of the team. Strong candidates may go straight to the CTO.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)

Team: Marketing

  Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

 

The role

This is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific.

Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win.
This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster.

You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer.

Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company
  • Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise
  • Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use
  • Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed
  • Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason
  • Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions
  • Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations (Core)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

 
 About This Role: 

 We are looking for a Head of Product Operations (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.

 This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product. 

 
 Our Benefits: 

 At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

 
 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

 A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.
 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will : 

 
 Drive end-to-end fraud management and detection strategies across all product types and payment flows . 

 Streamline customer support workflows to improve resolution speed, operational efficiency, and user trust . 

 Oversee the operational maintenance and reliability of coupon auto-apply and app-to-app features.

 Partner with Finance to forecast and manage cash allocations and liquidity across provider accounts . 

 Work cross-functionally with Product and key teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions . 

 Champion AI and automation initiatives to generate operational insights and drive continuous process improvements . 

 
 
 Your Profile: 

 We're looking for someone with 

 
 3 - 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech

 Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions. 

 Operational Excellence: Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.

 Leadership & Collaboration: A strong leadership track record

 Mindset: A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.

 Language requirements: Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.

 
 
 Our hiring process: 

 
 TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.

 Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager.

 Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a highly-driven Technical Product Manager who can provide organisation and coordination support for our engineering initiatives. Technology is core to our business, and this role is an opportunity to work alongside our engineers as we build and optimise Jane Street’s trading technology.

You’ll draw from your technical background on a daily basis, leading projects through their entire lifecycle, including defining goals, developing timelines, tracking milestones, managing developer time, identifying risks, and coordinating with related teams. You’ll also communicate project schedules, priorities, and status updates to the larger organisation.

Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities will be necessary to collaborate across a wide range of teams at Jane Street—including developers, business teams, operations, support—as well as with external financial entities, to make sure each project is delivered on time and meets or exceeds stated goals and expectations.

We operate in a flexible problem-solving environment that encourages people to think outside the box when developing processes and tools for the project at hand. The person in this role needs to be a strategic thinker who considers the goals of the group and project when problem solving.

This role sits within Jane Street’s technology group which designs, deploys, and supports all of the infrastructure that underpins our trading activities. The scope of our systems is large, and you'll gain insight into a broad cross section of the global market as you work to improve them. To succeed in this role, you must enjoy working independently on small teams, learning on the fly, and making decisions that have a real and immediate impact on the firm.

At Jane Street, the “P” in TPM can mean a lot of different things. Depending on the team, the person, and the circumstances, you may find yourself anywhere on the spectrum from Product Manager to Program Manager. As a result, you’ll be most successful at Jane Street if you’re comfortable with that sort of ambiguity, and happy to roll your sleeves up and dig into the problem at hand, bringing whatever relevant skills you have to bear, whether through large-scale program management and coordination, product vision, business context, or anything else. That’s also why you’ll find a second job posting for “Technical Program Manager” elsewhere on the site that looks just like this one - feel free to apply to whichever you think fits your experience and interests better and we’ll make sure your profile ends up in the right pipeline.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
jobs.description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam , Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.
 I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.
 
 About WeTravel:
 Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.
 WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.
 This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.
 We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.
 
 What's the role:
 You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:
 Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

 Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

 Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

 Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

 
 What you'll do day-to-day: 
 Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

 Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

 Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

 Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

 
 How we work:
 We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

 We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

 We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

 Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

 
 You should apply if you have:
 
 Basic qualifications: 
 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

 Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

 Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

 Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

 Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

 Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

 Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural e

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Nantes (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.
 Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.
 Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.
  
 
What you'll do 
 Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

 Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

 Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

 Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

 Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

 Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

  
 
Who you are 
 Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
  
 You'll be a great fit if you: 
 You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

 You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

 You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

 You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

 You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

 You are fluent in English

  
 It would be fantastic if you: 
 Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

 Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

 Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

  
 
What we offer 
 Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

 Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

 Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

 A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

 ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

 Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

 For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 Relocation support in case of international mobility

 Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

  
 
Our interview process 
 Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime)

 Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste) 

 Case Study with Product Panel

 Behavioral Interview

 At least one reference check

 We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page .

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 
 
 Preferred starting date: ASAP
 Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)
 Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
 Report to: CEO

 
 About the company 
 Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.
 Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.
 We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.
 
 Your role 
 As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.
 This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.
 You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.
 
 Your responsibilities will include 
 • Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.
 • Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.
 • Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.
 • Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.
 • User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.
 • Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).
 • Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.
 • Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.
 • Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.
 • Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.
 
 What you will deliver in your first year 
 • A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.
 • A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.
 • Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.
 • Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.
 • A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.
 • Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training f

jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Face

  • Provide comprehensive project status updates and risk assessments to peers and senior management. Ensure transparent communication across all stakeholders, enhancing project visibility and confidence. 
  • Seek knowledge, refine domain skills, and work collaboratively for team success. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth, developing advanced technical skills.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (d/f/m) - People Intelligence Apps
jobs.description:
Our story:
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
 
 Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 
 The opportunity:   
 As our People Intelligence/Apps Technical Product Manager within the People Strategy & Insights team, you'll be a critical part of developing our agentic enablement platform and responsible for building and shipping the People applications that power how we hire, develop, and grow our team — from workforce planning tools to AI-augmented performance and org design solutions. 
Reporting to our Director of People Strategy & Insights and collaborating closely with People Partners, Leaders, FP&A, IT, and AI and Platform Engineering, you'll translate complex People domain challenges into elegant, scalable products that make a real difference in how we operate. At Taxfix, we're building an AI-native company — and this role sits right at the heart of that mission.
 
 
 Your responsibilities 
 Develop a deep understanding of the employee as “Builder” concept, and map the requirements different parts of the organisation have to unlock the capability of Engineers and non-Engineers to ship agentic workflows.

 Design and implement AI-augmented tools and human-AI collaboration patterns, experimenting with emerging techniques to push the boundaries of what's possible in People operations.

 Build, iterate, and continuously improve People applications using no-code and low-code platforms such as Claude Code, Notion, n8n, Google Cloud Apps, and other AI tools — owning the full product lifecycle from concept through delivery and optimisation.

 Lead the continued adaption of Product mindset and ways of working across the People function, including the development and on going refinement of the People Products Roadmap.

 Translate stakeholder needs into a prioritised People applications roadmap, balancing day-to-day operational demands with longer-term strategic initiatives and a clear build-vs-buy framework.

 Build and maintain integrations across the People tech stack — including HiBob, Ashby, Peakon, and Postgres — ensuring seamless data flows, strong data integrity, and reliable automation via n8n.

 Lead change management for new applications and features, creating documentation, training materials, and enablement sessions, then gathering feedback to iterate rapidly.

 Partner with PSI leadership, People Partners, Workforce Planners, and FP&A, while collaborating with IT and Engineering to ensure all solutions meet IT security and privacy standards.

 

 Your profile 
 You bring 5+ years of experience in technical product management or a closely related role, with a proven track record of building and shipping internal tools end-to-end.

 You have hands-on experience building with AI tools such as Claude, GPT, or Google AI Studio, and you think naturally about how to design effective human-AI collaboration patterns.

 You are a curious PM that is not afraid to challenge the status quo in a pragmatic and constructive way.

 You are thinking in systems, understanding the economical aspect of internal processes and products and how those can create value.

 You are technically fluent, comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and cross-system data flows, and you know when to bring in Engineering versus when to build it yourself.

 You have a product mindset: you manage roadmaps, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver incremental value in fast-paced environments, all while keeping the end user's experience front and centre.

 You are highly proficient with no-code and low-code platforms, Notion, n8n, AppSheet, Google Cloud Apps, or similar, and you're comfortable designing data models that support complex business logic and reporting.

 Experience in People or HR tech, workforce planning, or org design is a strong plus, as is a background in high-growth startup or scale-up environments where ambiguity is the norm, not the exception.

 Why Taxfix? 
 A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

 Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

 A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

 Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

 A generous lear

jobs.title: Senior Product Management Builder (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story: 
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
 Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 AI is shifting how the best products get built. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread.
 At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders .
 A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions.
 Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized.
 Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. If building the thing sounds more natural to you than describing it, this role is for you.
  
 Your responsibilities and decisions: 
 Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped product. Write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, and get it in front of users, with as few handoffs as possible. Own the full loop. 

 Compress research, synthesis, and spec-writing from weeks into hours. You reach for AI tools not because you’ve been asked to, but because they faster make you faster in delivering high quality outcome. You know when to trust the output, when to edit it, and when to reject it. Use AI as a force multiplier. 

 You structure fuzzy problems, identify what should and shouldn’t be built, and move forward when there are dozens of possible directions. The magic is in the trade-offs, not the feature list. Turn ambiguous ideas into things users can trust. 

 You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-related product work, translating AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, and outputs into clear product decisions. You work effectively in hybrid human-AI teams. Work in small, focused teams. 

 You know the metric your team is trying to move. You measure your week by what changed in user behaviour, not by how many tickets moved to Done. Be accountable to outcomes, not roadmaps. 

 You give feedback directly, to anyone, regardless of level. You raise blockers early and in the open. Push back when something’s wrong. Team player who raises the bar. 

  
 Your profile: 
 
 Your craft
 5+ years experience in Product Management (ideally in fintech or B2B). You’ve shipped things that real people use, and you can point to the metric that moved when you did.

 Understand implicitly the product development process - from discovery, to user research to experimentation. You are able to build and defend a compelling strategy that solves user needs.

 You have a builder track record: you’ve made things with AI, not just written specs about them. Shipped products, agent workflows, or tools real users have touched. Any of these count whether at work or in your personal life.

 You’re AI-native by default. You use tools like Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or similar regularly. You follow the AI product space closely and you know the difference between a demo and something production-ready.

 You’ve built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster. You know when to trust AI output, when to edit it, and when to reject it.

 You’ve gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief to be written for you. The output was good enough that a team shipped from it.

 Low PM baggage: you’re not attached to how product management "should" be done. You care about outcomes, not territory.

 When designing and shipping AI-enabled products, you consider privacy, safety, fairness, transparency, bias, and accountability. You assess when AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use and raise concerns when risks or limitations are identified.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Kernel
 Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
 
 Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
 
 Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
 
 Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout  already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
 
 We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY .
 
 The role 
 You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team
 Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

 Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

 Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

 Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

 Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel

 
 What we’re looking for
 We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.
 Scar tissue : 6+ years of Product Management experience in an early-stage environment, where you’ve learned the hard way what works and what doesn’t, and built complex products and features along the way

 Evals: Comfortable with evals for agents and driving quality improvements via evals and recursive self-improvement

 The Role

Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.
 You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale.  Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture
