jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
In just over two years, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world's carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.
 We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer to own design at Spruce: someone whose bar for craft is higher than ours, and who wants to set the standard for what our product looks and feels like as it gets more ambitious.
 
 🌲 About Spruce
 Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

 We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

 We raised a chunky Seed round from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're just about to launch solar and battery, and we're ultimately building the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

 
 🥖 The role
 Our product handles building physics, fluid dynamics modelling and compliance – and is about to do a whole lot more. The job is to make all of that quick, intuitive and even delightful for a tradesperson who wants to spend as little time as possible at their desk. We've been design-led since the beginning, but the challenge is only growing as the product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you'll be:
 Owning design at Spruce – Setting the design direction and standards across the product, deciding what good looks like, and building the practice (critique, tooling, rituals) that lets us keep shipping fast as the product and team grow. You'll work alongside our two product designers, raising the bar on their work as well as your own.

 Doing the hardest design work yourself – This is a hands-on role. You'll take the gnarliest flows end to end: desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl. LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work for everyone from a 3-person local installer to a national utility.

 Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs ship quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team).

 Researching and validating – Spending time with installers on site to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems are; building quick prototypes to test decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

 You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.
 
 🫵 About you
 We're looking for a designer with 6+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially much more) , including time as the most senior designer on a product or team – ideally in a startup or a fast-moving, impact-focussed environment. We'd love to speak with you if you have:
 Exceptional craft – You have a very high bar for UI execution and sweat the interaction details. You can point to work you'd happily put next to the best B2B products out there, and you can explain exactly why it's good.

 A point of view – You hold strong design opinions, argue for them, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You'd rather be challenged than left alone.

 Comfort in complexity – You're a clear, systematic thinker who enjoys technical detail, even in a domain that's new to you.

 User obsession – You've run research with real customers yourself, not via a research team, and you've shipped things that measurably changed how they work.

 Range – You're proactive and self-organising, happy running several projects at once and switching between strategy and pixels in the same afternoon.

 Bonus if you've worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or operational workflows – but absolutely not

jobs.description:
What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳
 Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.
 
 We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.
 
 Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.
 
 If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.
 
 What will I be doing? ‍‍ 👩‍💻👨‍💻
 We’re looking for a mission-driven Product Manager to join our Product function and help scale the value of Sylvera’s live products. You’ll take products that have found market fit and make them great - taking them from 1 to 2, rather than 0 to 1.
 This is a high-impact role. You’ll be trusted to own your areas and expected to execute autonomously, and we’ll invest in you to set you up for success. You’ll join our product guild, and learn from passionate and experienced colleagues who are enthusiastic about sharing knowledge.
 
 Specific responsibilities will include: 
 Focus on one or more product areas at a time within a defined problem space, across the Sylvera B2B SaaS platform, iterating on existing products to unlock their full value

 Talking to customers regularly and running discovery to understand their workflow deeply, from finding the problem through to launching the solution, and monitoring its impact

 Using product data and customer insight to find what holds users back, and proposing the improvements that matter most in high impact areas

 Working closely with engineering, design and data teams to build, and marketing and sales to launch improvements at pace.

 Engaging and partnering with stakeholders across the business - the changes you’ll make will have a high impact, so you’ll bring people’s ideas and input together to build better product experiences

 Partnering with commercial colleagues to grow revenue and usage by helping users get more value from Sylvera’s data

 Supporting larger strategic initiatives alongside the wider product team
 

 We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚
 Has experience as a Product Manager, ideally on a B2B SaaS product

 Has worked closely with customers and run their own discovery through to delivery

 Is data-driven, using analytics and customer insight to make decisions, with a track record of iterating on live products

 Is naturally curious and loves learning new domains - no carbon market experience needed, but we’d expect you to proactively learn about the world our customers operate in

 Is comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can adapt quickly as the picture becomes clearer.

 Enjoys working with people across a business, listening to different views and turning them into clear product decisions, rather than taking pre-defined requirements

 Ideally has worked on data products, or has a strong appreciation of how value is derived from data and how to build SaaS experiences that maximise it

 Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

 Cares deeply about the climate

 We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

 Local bar tab at the end of the month

 Weekly drinks in the office

London. We work flexibly whilst encouraging people to come in regularly to our great office in Old St

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.
 STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.
 STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.
 The role. As a Senior Commercial Product Manager, you own a portfolio of our most important customers. You are responsible for the success of each deployment, for the value it creates for the customer, and for growing the relationship from initial pilot to organisation-wide rollout. You work directly with their C-suite and sales leadership to understand their business model, their commercial priorities, and where untapped growth potential lies across their markets, segments and accounts.
 You translate those priorities into what STRATOS delivers. You define what the solution needs to do, work with our engineers to make sure it gets built right, and bring the results back to the customer's decision-makers. You bridge two worlds: the customer's commercial reality and our product.
 Your responsibility doesn't end at go-live. You stay at the customer's side as they put the solution to work: challenging their thinking, helping them act on what the data shows, and making sure the impact is visible in their results.
 This role suits someone who wants to own outcomes rather than just recommend them. Beyond your own accounts, you help shape the direction of STRATOS – what we build, how we deploy it and how we grow.
 The roles you'll play 
 Trusted advisor to the C-suite — work directly with executive teams and sales leadership on where to play, how to win, and how to organise and steer a sales force. You are the person they call before they decide, not after.

 Owner of the customer, end to end — from first pilot to multi-country rollout, the deployment, the relationship and the results are yours. Our engineers build it; you decide what gets built and you stand behind whether it worked.

 Commercial owner of your portfolio — you are responsible for its growth: expansion into new use cases and new markets, and the judgement of when a customer is ready for more and when they are not.

 Product manager for your market — you translate what you see across your customers into our roadmap, define what gets built, and own it with engineering through to release.

 Builder of the function — you shape how STRATOS deploys and scales: the standards, the tooling and the people. Senior CPMs coach the CPMs around them.

 Who this is for. We hire for commercial judgement and the credibility to hold a room of executives. That does not come from one background, and we are open about where yours comes from.
 What we're actually looking for:
 You have owned a complex piece of work end to end — scoping it, aligning stakeholders who disagreed, delivering it, and being accountable for whether it worked. We're interested in people who ran the engagement, not only staffed it.

 You can hold your own with a commercial director who has run their business for twenty years and change their mind with evidence rather than seniority.

 You do your own analysis. You are comfortable in the data, and you'd rather check the number yourself than take it from a slide.

 You can explain something complicated to someone non-technical without making them feel stupid.

 You are genuinely interested in how industrial businesses make money — pricing, channels, sales coverage, market structure.

 You want to be somewhere your decisions are visible. At our size, the roadmap changes because of what you bring back.

 This is probably not for you if you want a defined remit, a stable set of processes, or a role where strategy and delivery are separate jobs. 
 What we offer 
 Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

 A highly competitive salary

 Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

 Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

 Private healthcare

 Pension scheme

 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

 Work from abroad

About us 
 At STRATOS Technologies, we are transforming how companies make data-driven decisions. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, enabling businesses to strengthen their long-term strategies through clear and actionable insights.
 Our founders, former business and tech executives who led a $1B division at a Fortune 500 industrial company, originally built a digital twin of their enterprise to drive synchronized planning and execution. Seeing the market’s lack of such a system, they launched STRATOS in 2022 with a bold mission: to unifiy all internal and external data into a single platform.
 Today, STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.
 From commercial AI agents to embedded intelligence that supercharges lean teams, STRATOS enables businesses to achieve 10x productivity and strengthen long-term strategies through actionable insights. We are now expanding our team to accelerate our growth even further and help our customers outperform their competition
 The role. You own a piece of the relationship with one of our customers: their data, their questions, and whether the product answers them. You will do the analysis, present it to their commercial leadership, and take what you learn back to our engineers as something we should build. The difference from where you are now is that you stay with it. You see whether the recommendation worked, and when it doesn't, you're the one who fixes it.
 The roles you'll play 
 Owner of a workstream — take a defined part of the deployment end to end: the market model, the target list or the scoring logic, from first data through to something the customer's teams use every week.

 Advisor to the customer's commercial team — run working sessions with sales and commercial leadership, present your own analysis, and handle the challenge yourself. You are in the room, not behind it.

 Co-owner of the account — you share the relationship with a senior CPM and take on more of it as the year goes on, up to running a customer of your own.

 Voice of the customer in our roadmap — turn what you see in the field into what we build, and stay with it through the roadmap until it ships.

 Builder of how we work — sharpen the standards, templates and tooling that make the next deployment better than the last.

 Who this is for. Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or an analytical commercial role.
 You have run a workstream yourself: not just the analysis, but the stakeholder who didn't want to give you the data and the deadline that moved.

 You are quick in data and you check your own numbers. Excel and PowerPoint are assumed; any SQL or Python is a bonus, not a requirement, and we'll teach you what you need.

 You can present to people twenty years your senior without either deferring to them or lecturing them.

 You are curious about how industrial businesses actually work — how a building-materials group reaches its customers, why a distributor behaves the way it does.

 You want more responsibility than your peers get, and you understand that comes with being the one who is wrong in public sometimes.

 This probably isn't for you if you want to specialise early, or if you'd rather be handed a defined analysis than decide what the right question is. 
 What we offer 
 Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

 A highly competitive salary

 Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

 Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

 Private healthcare

 Pension scheme

 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

 Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

 Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

 A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

 Practicalities 
 London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

 Travel to some customer sites around, mostly within Europe

 German is genuinely useful here and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not a requirement

 The process 
 First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes

 Tehcncial case interview — 45 minutes

 Hiring manager interview with a senior executive - 30 minutes

 Second senior executive interview, which may include a case exercise - 30 minutes

 Final stage with our CEO - 45 minutes

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Product Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro 

 Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

 De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

 Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

 Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling
 

 Over FAAC Technologie 
 FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.
 De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.
 
 
 Wie ben jij 
 Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting

 Je hebt ervaring met productmanagement, productmarketing, marktanalyses of een vergelijkbare functie

 Je hebt affiniteit met technische producten en weet commerciële kansen te herkennen

 Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt marktinformatie vertalen naar concrete productverbeteringen

 Je hebt inzicht in prijsstrategieën, productpositionering en portfolio-optimalisatie

 Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders

 Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

 Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet prioriteiten te stellen

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 About the role
 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.
  
 What you'll do
 Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

 Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

  
 What you'll bring
 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

 Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.
